title: Design System: I learn arch btw

display.purpose: Large course and lesson headings with a measured, fixed-width voice.

label.purpose: Commands, state, progress, module labels, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: terminal-offset
shadows.purpose: Separate the hero terminal readout from the black data field.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Short interaction transitions for navigation and controls.

motion.name: field-scan
motion.purpose: One periodic scan line in the hero data field.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: A square black action that inverts on hover.
components.css: .primary-button { background: #080808; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #080808; border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 15px 14px 17px; font-family: monospace; } .primary-button:hover { background: #fff; color: #080808; }

components.name: Practice terminal
components.description: A safe browser-only shell with explicit objectives and reset control.
components.css: .terminal-practice { background: #080808; color: #fff; padding: 26px; } .practice-terminal { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24); }

narrative.overview: The page behaves like a small black-and-white data instrument. It records position, exposes command intent, and provides a safe place to practice. Dense fixed-width readouts are balanced by quiet ruled reading space.
keyCharacteristics: Progress as a register, not a dashboard

rules.name: The inversion rule
rules.body: Use contrast shifts to show state. Do not add a decorative accent hue.

rules.name: The data voice rule
rules.body: Use monospace for commands, measurement, navigation labels, and display headlines. Keep explanations in the body face.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: Use rules and tonal surfaces for depth. Reserve the small offset for the hero terminal readout.

dos: Do make the safety boundary visible near the practice input.
Do use inversion for active, selected, and completed states.
donts: Don't restore rounded dashboard cards or gradient decoration.
Don't let the data field replace the real command interaction.
